body:
Pass 2. Volume stencil looks great - 97k voxels in 2.35s, genuinely linear. One issue filed as bd-01KZXBT2GF4E4W9N685KAHAYER (p1): .coordinate_ball_members keeps an O(p x n_groups) term because it splits on character cell keys and indexes groups[candidate_keys] per centre. 287 us/voxel at p=50653 vs 24 for the stencil; at p=8000 it is only 1.5x faster than the all-pairs loop it replaced. Confirmed by holding p fixed and varying radius - lookup-only time tracks n_groups (8.49s at 15625 groups vs 2.31s at 343). Not caught because the 50k test uses volume_domain and asserts storage only. Fix: integer cell codes + one vectorised match(). Blocker note added to Epic 1.

Pass-1 items are still unacked: bd-01KZXBD69V5PFTKTVBXDNKZT7J (p0, frame/metric composition + conservation law) and bd-01KZXBDP92BNX44VWW08M35VQZ (K-inverse action in the metric handle). The p0 one decides what 'a' is, so it is worth settling before Epic 2 starts.
